entities.title: Shared test fixture
entities.summary: One fixture, demo_zone_rules(), that loads the pinned demo zone rules for both example suites.
entities.purpose: Gives the UTV-first and native-first suites the same zone rules: conformance/rules/demo-zones.json, read in place through ZoneRules::load. Each suite includes mod.rs as its own fixtures module (#[path = "../fixtures/mod.rs"]), so the fixture's test runs in both.
boundaries: Reads the rule bundle from the repository; it is never copied here.
Not a test target of its own: Cargo builds it only as a module of tests/utv_first and tests/native_first.
